notes.title: What's new in v2.1 update
notes.notes:
- Settings UI Revamp: We've given the settings interface a fresh new look! 
- Discover our apps: Explore our other app offerings from within Boom 3D (on the left, in the title bar)
- Defect fixes and improvements: Your listening experience is our top priority, and we have deployed some defect fixes to improve it.

We hope you enjoy it. Please feel free to contact us with feedback, suggestions, and feature requests at boom3@globaldelight.com. We’re all ears! :)

notes.title: What's New in this version
notes.notes: A minor bug related to AirPlay has been fixed.

notes.title: What's New in v1.3.17 update
notes.notes: External Display Volume Control - You can now adjust the volume of an external display (that has been selected as a sound output device) using the system volume control. (The volume of the external device will remain relative to the system volume.)

notes.title: Boom 3D Version 1.3.5
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we have a new update for you guys! Here are the deets:

Added the option to enable sound output to external display automatically when connected to the system.
Minor bug fixes and performance improvements


Check it out, and please let us know your feedback so that we can keep improving Boom 3D for you!

Cheers!
